title: Quotient coefficient presentations and exact derived scalar restriction
statement: Let $W$ be a small ringed site with chosen unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation], and $Q$ a complex of $O_W$-modules. A quotient coefficient presentation consists of a commutative ring sheaf $A$, a locally surjective ring-sheaf map $O_W\to A$, a chosen derived category of $A$-modules and its derived tensor model, exactness of the ordinary restriction functor on finite limits and finite colimits, and an isomorphism $Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{A/O_W}(A)[0]$. Restriction is the actual scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define the corresponding quotient ringed site on the same underlying site, and the derived restriction functor by localization of this exact scalar restriction.
